cta_candidates.text: Mariposa places soldiers and researchers within the same guarded facility, but their responsibilities give them very different access to what's happening there. Maxson's men provide security for a project whose human cost becomes clear to them only after they're already involved in protecting it. That arrangement matters. The soldiers haven't arrived to investigate a hostile laboratory. They discover the experiments inside their own chain of command, among people working under government authority.
